items.area: Native multi-asset ProductCapabilities and cross-product authority boundary
items.resolution: Closed after exact-head certification on f9ec065302a798a48a51b092fd6835a46416a2af: crypto ProductCapabilities is bound to exact broker asset evidence, its fingerprint is persisted in the durable lifecycle and prepared package, the last-write Final Guard requires fresh CRYPTO ProductCapabilities bound to fresh asset evidence and the same stable product contract, and permanent execution/product CI scans the complete alpaca_paper_crypto_*.py production family for cross-product authority leakage while preserving the certified US-equity session/bracket contract.

items.area: Crypto protective lifecycle after confirmed entry fills
items.next_action: Wire the durable protection PRE_CONSUME checkpoint through a dedicated no-network protection execution bridge that consumes only the same human-approved attempt and stages the exact protective OMS order as SUBMITTING. Then require the protection PRE_IO Final Guard at the last-write boundary before any broker transport call. Certify crash/restart after PRE_CONSUME and after human-authority consumption, exact-position rebinding denial, UNKNOWN=>RECONCILE_ONLY, zero duplicate POST, partial/trigger-without-fill outcomes and PROTECTION_AT_RISK without reusing equity bracket authority.

items.area: Crypto PAPER writer idempotency, UNKNOWN-before-I/O and reconciliation
items.next_action: Remove the direct enabled-writer bypass found in the exact-head audit: no raw AlpacaPaperCryptoWriter(enabled=True) call may reach a transport using only ENTRY_PREPARED/PROTECTION_PREPARED lifecycle state. The writer/last-write boundary must require role-specific, self-consistent PRE_IO authority bound to the exact client_order_id, durable UNKNOWN attempt, OMS SUBMITTING state and human-approved attempt for ENTRY and PROTECTION. Preserve exact PAPER host/path, UNKNOWN-before-I/O, zero blind retry and GET-only reconciliation; add CI that fails if any production caller can bypass the guarded last-write path. No broker POST is allowed before TD-R6-015 and TD-R6-016 are exact-head green under this stronger contract.

items.area: Crypto 24/7 PAPER qualification and residual-risk evidence
items.next_action: After writer and protection certification, run bounded human-approved PAPER canaries across multiple UTC/liquidity/weekend conditions and persist fills, fees, spread, slippage, protection acknowledgements/outcomes, reconciliation and stop-limit residual-risk evidence. Connectivity/rehearsal success alone cannot close this debt or support profitability claims.
